message:
the pattern read 6 of the 7 decorators the TypeScript parser holds, and not these:
      libs/components/widget/src/zeta.ts:15
$reason: A decorator behind a comment on its line in `zeta.ts`, the comment padded so that its `@` stands at the offset of the base's decorator in `base.ts`, which the pattern reads (the case carries its own copy of the reference's `base.ts`, so the two offsets stay one). The decorators the pattern read are held file by file: a set of offsets shared across the files would take the base's for this one, and the case would pass every point.
